data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2017 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 232.724m. During 2017 the syndicate experienced substantial catastrophe activity (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria) and a reassessment of prior accident years produced a net prior-year deficit of GBP 2.0m (net). The report explicitly describes a reassessment of prior-year claims (net deficit), but does not provide an explicit aggregate GROSS prior-year movement figure. As a result a gross prior-year development figure cannot be reliably extracted from the disclosed notes and triangle without additional assumptions. The primary drivers cited are adverse claims development related to large-loss catastrophe activity and recalibration of IBNR/previous estimates.

data.data_quality_notes: The report provides a net prior-year reassessment figure (a net deficit of GBP 2.0m) but does not provide an explicit aggregate GROSS prior-year development figure in a single note. The gross claims development triangle is present but the published layout in the PDF extract is ambiguous for deriving previous-diagonal values reliably. Therefore no definitive gross prior-year development amount is reported here. If a gross PYD is required, additional extraction from the full claims development triangle (with precise row-to-column alignment) or from an explicit 'movement in prior year claims (insurance liabilities)' line would be necessary.
